title: Qualify finite formal polynomial certificate and proof-status research
commitMessage: docs: qualify M7 polynomial certificate research

contribution.summary: Qualify M7-W02-C01-T1 as finite formal interoperability research: replay a machine-readable Z[x] polynomial identity certificate with independent BCL BigInteger convolution; altered or truncated certificates are invalid, while holes, timeouts and provider errors remain unproved. Start W02/C01 and complete T1 Q/O/D only; admit no external proof kernel, provider, formal API or public package.
contribution.value: Stage a source-owned certificate for (x-1)(x+1)=x^2-1 with ascending coefficients [-1,0,1], independently replay its exact integer-convolution witness and negative failure states, and screen Lean/Rocq/SMT trusted bases, license/version/TFM/RID and source-free consumer requirements. Evidence explicitly separates one checked finite identity from a general proof engine or kernel theorem.
debtChanges: One independently checked finite polynomial coefficient certificate is not a Lean/Rocq kernel proof, SMT theorem certificate or general prover.
An altered/truncated proof is invalid; a hole, missing evidence, timeout or provider failure stays unproved regardless of sampled values.
Any formal provider needs a named consumer and trusted kernel, immutable version/source/license/TFM/RID, resource costs and independent source-free proof replay.
Math may own qualified certificate data only; AURA provider execution, scheduling and permissions remain separately owned.
Formal C01 T2, W02 C02 review and M7 release remain incomplete; no new Math.formal package or public NuGet is authorized.
contribution.nextAction: After durable RS118 success, prepare M7-W02-C01-T2 to decide the proof trusted base, exact certificate/error statuses, toolchain/rights/RID and owner/source-free gate; qualify a provider only with independent evidence, otherwise defer. Keep coverage C02 and M7 gate open.

achievements.achievement: Define finite Z[x] polynomial certificate research and distinguish derivation, checked certificate and external proof-kernel claims.
Replay the exact [-1,0,1] coefficient witness and falsify altered/truncated certificates, holes, timeouts and failed providers.
Screen Lean/Rocq/SMT candidate trusted-base, source/rights/RID and source-free requirements without adopting a solver.
Complete source-pinned finite polynomial identity research Q/O/D while keeping C01/T2 and formal product admission open.
